title: Runway Velocity & Decision Guardrails for SSO/SAML and Audit-Log Compliance Deliveries
creator: Ravi Patel
description: Goal: Define an executable milestone cadence and a small set of deterministic release guardrails that tie evidence velocity to release gates for SOC2/ISO and SSO/SAML + audit-log features. Rationale: Current compliance work drifts between squads because acceptance is qualitative and reviewer load is high. We need quantitative runway signals ("Runway Velocity") and clear pass/fail gates so product releases either ship with provable controls or are scoped down with documented mitigations. Scope: SSO/SAML integration, audit-log capture/retention pipeline, evidence artifacts (docs, tests, dashboards), security sign-off, and automation to reduce reviewer time. Out of scope: full org-level SOC2 readiness plan (this is delivery-level gating for product launches). Stakeholders: Security (lead: Anika Verma), Platform Eng (lead: Daniel Kim), Observability (lead: Jorge Alvarez), Legal (review), Customer Success (for enterprise customers), QA and Release Engineering. Deliverables: 1) Runway Velocity metric definition and Grafana panel, 2) Decision guardrail checklist and automated gate enforcement in release pipeline, 3) Standardized evidence template and checklist, 4) Runbook for rollback/mitigation when gates fail, 5) OKR mapping showing how gate success rolls up to Assurance OKRs.
acceptance_criteria: Runway Velocity metric defined and documented: formula, inputs, and criticality weights
Grafana dashboard showing historical velocity and projection for next 4 weeks is available
Release guardrail implemented as a checklist with binary checks for critical controls (>=90% completion) and soft checks for low-risk items
Automated gating hook added to canary pipeline that blocks canary promotions when any critical guardrail fails
Standard evidence template stored in Drive and linked from PR templates
Security sign-off workflow captured and represented as a single Slack approval step and a ticket flag
At least two pilot releases complete the gate workflow (internal feature + external enterprise trial) and documented learnings
comments: 2026-02-02 - Kickoff: Reviewed PRD with Security and Platform. Decision: prioritize SSO end-to-end test and retention validation for audit logs. Action: ENG to prototype velocity metric (owner: Daniel Kim).
2026-02-10 - Trade-off discussion: Automation increases lead time initially but reduces reviewer time by ~30%. Agreed to scope automation to critical controls only for first iteration.

2026-02-18 - Engineering update: Initial Grafana panel ETL complete (PR: github.com/redwood/observability/pulls/482). Panel exposes 'evidence_completed' and 'evidence_total' by week. Need weighting for 'critical' vs 'non-critical' artifacts.
2026-02-24 - Security feedback (Anika): Require full SAML E2E smoke (login, role mapping, session invalidation) before sign-off. Also requested retention proof for 90 days. Added as critical control.

2026-03-03 - Decision: Guardrail thresholds set to 90% for critical controls, 70% for non-critical. Fallback: if critical <90%, release may proceed only with documented mitigation, customer opt-in flag, and additional monitoring for 30 days.

2026-03-05 - PM update: Draft evidence template uploaded to Drive and linked to PR template. Link added below. Need UX for clear checklist display in Console when a customer requests enterprise onboarding.
2026-03-09 - Cross-functional review: Observability to add an alert when projected runway < 3 weeks. Release Engineering to implement gating hook in CI (ENG-82111).

2026-03-10 - Updated acceptance criteria: Added requirement for two pilot releases to validate operational playbook and rollback steps. Next steps: schedule pilot windows in Cycle 2026-W10 and 2026-W12.
